summary: VEILFALL: Ashes of the Nine is an isometric action RPG following Bearers from the Wayside Fire across the Broken Lantern Road, the Ashen Abbey and Bell Crypt, west to the Lanternmere, and east to Saint Corvin's Gallows Orchard. The main-place sim coordinates the Z01 chapters and shared encounters; player and boss scripts run action/combat, character.js persists Bearers, and the solo Veil place hosts menus.
places: places/main/ - shared playable Z01; sim.js owns quest chapters, encounters, turn-ins, ambience/music and boss lifecycle.
places/main/cells/ - five authored cells covering the Wayside Fire, road, Abbey/Crypt, western Fen/Lanternmere and eastern Gallows Orchard; orchard gallows span x0z0 and x1z0.
places/main/config.yaml - main terrain, atmosphere, procedural vegetation and 520000-byte arrival budget.
places/veil/ - ephemeral solo Lantern Shrine menu stage above the ravine; hidden menu body is parked here.
places/veil/cells/ and places/veil/config.yaml - authored shrine ledge, cliffs, far ridge, spawn and menu-stage environment.
places/veil/sim.js - selects menu theme and wind when no eligible Bearer is on main.
roots: world.config.yaml - world entry: main default place, player/camera templates, lighting, arrival behavior, nametag and desktop/touch action routing.
templates/player.js - Bladewraith body, humanoid-locomotion.js and scripts/player.js behavior, layout and carried-light child.
templates/camera.js - custom camera template running scripts/camera.js.
places/main/sim.js - Z01 referee for quests, NPCs, enemy packs, progression, rewards, bosses and ambience/music.
places/main/cells/ - authored playable terrain and dressing from the camp through Abbey/Crypt, Fen and Gallows Orchard.
places/veil/cells/ and places/veil/config.yaml - authored menu-stage shrine/ravine and spawn/environment.
places/veil/sim.js - Veil wind and menu-theme selection when no eligible Bearer is on main.
scripts/arrival.js - world doorway behavior; saves an active Bearer when leaving main.
shared: scripts/lib/character.js - Bearer schema, fresh state, realm roster/create/load/save/delete and packed position; player and arrival reuse it.
scripts/db.js and scripts/lib/data/realms.yml - character-table schema and realm room/name registry for player menus and UI.
scripts/lib/data/economy.yml and scripts/lib/coins.js - copper denomination, drops, rewards, sell values and shop stock used by sim, combat, shop and HUD.
scripts/lib/data/combat.yml - hero/skill/enemy and Bailiff, Ringer, Warden and Hangman tuning consumed by player, enemy and boss systems.
scripts/lib/data/veilfall-map.js - shared Z01 floor/area geometry for road, Abbey, Nave, Crypt, Fen and Gallows Orchard; consumed by terrain, player and zone banners.
scripts/lib/data/menu-shot.yml and scripts/lib/data/models.js - Veil framing and CDN actor model IDs/heights/body(kind) helper used by camera and spawners.
scripts/lib/frames.js, scripts/lib/data/ui-kit.js and scripts/lib/shop-ui.js - shared HUD styling and shop-panel presentation used by UI.
art/roadkit/common.py - offline Blender construction/material/render helpers imported by roadkit and Abbey builders.
notableExports: places/main/sim.js - cadence, tick; places/veil/sim.js - cadence, tick.
scripts/player.js - onSpawn, onInput, update; scripts/ui.js - default HUD/menu renderer.
scripts/wax-pack.js - roll, telegraph, hurtPlayers, payout, update; scripts/bailiff.js, scripts/ringer.js, scripts/warden.js and scripts/hangman.js - onSpawn, update.
scripts/lib/character.js - CHAR_KEYS, fresh, START, realmOf, pack, zoneOf, rollName, roster, create, load, save, remove.
scripts/lib/shop.js - owned, shopInput; scripts/lib/shop-ui.js - shopPanel; scripts/controls.js - default touch-surface selector.
scripts/lib/data/models.js - MODELS, HEIGHT, body; scripts/lib/data/veilfall-map.js - FEN_PATH, WAYSTONES, FEN_HEART, ORCH_PATH, GIBBETS, GALLOWS, floorDist, orchDist, areaAt.
scripts/gen/fen-kit.js - shared Fen geometry/material helpers; fen-waystone.js exports NICHE, geometry, collider; other fen generators export geometry and colliders where applicable.
scripts/gen/ossuary-cart.js - geometry, collider; scripts/gen/censer.js - geometry; scripts/gen/penitent-wheel.js - geometry, collider.
ownership: scripts/lib/character.js CHAR_KEYS - persistent Bearer fields including quest/reward claims, bossKilled, ringerKilled, wardenKilled and hangmanKilled; packed position is separate.
scripts/player.js - active body's movement, combat, death/i-frame and skill timers, menu/selection scratch, per-Bearer floor gates and selected Bearer hydration/save.

places/main/sim.js - per-player quest/dialog/cut progress and claimed rewards; NPC/shop range, enemy packs, progression, boss spawning/reset coordination, orchard gibbet visibility and ambience/music orchestration.
scripts/wax-pack.js - ordinary enemy AI/hp/death and eligible nearby Bearers' XP/copper/kills/shards payouts.

scripts/bailiff.js, scripts/ringer.js, scripts/warden.js and scripts/hangman.js - respective boss hp/phases/casts/adds/defeat; publish place.state boss rows and set persistent participant defeat flags.
scripts/lib/shop.js - trade validation and buyer copper, tonics, bag and maxHp mutations; shop-open state is on player.state.
scripts/camera.js - camera behavior; scripts/ui.js - menus, HUD and boss/quest presentation from player/place state.
flows: world.config.yaml attaches scripts/player.js through templates/player.js and maps desktop/touch actions; UI menu actions → player.js routes title/realm/character/create/enter/logout.
player.js menuInput → character.js roster/create/load/remove using caller-owned character rows; realms.yml maps selected realm to room and Bearer fields hydrate player.state.
While player.state.menu is set, player.js hides the body and moves it to solo place veil → realm/Bearer screens remain state-driven, with no characters in that place.
scripts/controls.js selects menu touch surface when player/charId is absent or menu active and while shop/bag is open; otherwise world.config.yaml supplies fight controls.
scripts/ui.js renders menus/HUD from player/place state → actions return through player.js; shop-ui.js presents shop buttons and shop.js validates trades.
scripts/camera.js reads target.state.menu and menu-shot.yml for Veil framing; entering play transitions to follow view.
player.js saves changed CHAR_KEYS plus position periodically/on rest → character.js writes characters; arrival.js saves an active Bearer leaving main.
player.js derives Abbey/Nave/Fen/Orchard floor gates from quest stage (4/10/13/18) or abbeyOpenAll, then uses veilfall-map.js floorDist for goals and movement/dash.

main sim advances Abbey/Nave through stage 13, Fen through 17 and Gallows Orchard 18–22; stages 18→19 enter orchard, stage 19 records three timed rope cuts, stage 20 summons Hangman, stage 21 turn-in claims Z01-MAIN-09 and advances to 22.
main sim tracks each Bearer's cut list and toggles orchard hanged props from active quest progress; scripts/hangman.js publishes place.state.hangman, and ui.js renders its engaged boss bar/hint.
main sim spawns Bailiff/Ringer/Warden/Hangman with models.js body(kind); each boss script owns its fight and marks participants on defeat, while sim owns quest progression/reset/spawn timing.
main sim selects enemy kind/model → combat.yml tunes stats and models.js supplies CDN bodies; wax-pack.js resolves ordinary kills, while main and Veil sims coordinate room-shared jukebox music.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/hub-*.js - reusable Wayside Fire camp props varied by instance params, seed and scene transform; share hub-kit.js.
scripts/gen/vf-*.js other than vf-ruin.js - Broken Lantern Road landmarks/clutter varied by parameters and seeds, built with vf-kit.js.
scripts/gen/vf-ruin.js - road, arena, Wax Veil approach, Veil ashlar and Abbey door braziers; kind/dimensions select forms, seed varies geometry.
scripts/gen/veil-land.js and veil-shrine.js - Veil ledge/cliff/ridge forms vary by kind/dimensions; the unique Lantern Shrine exports structure and hook constants.
scripts/gen/arena-floor.js, arena-pillar.js, gibbet.js and toll-throne.js - Bailiff arena dressing generators sharing scripts/gen/shapes.js and its soot-stained wax palette.
scripts/gen/abbey-litter.js and abbey-court.js - Abbey yard/Crypt litter and court dressing; litter varies by kind/seed/transform, court makes ringed slabs and a clear local -Z door path.
scripts/gen/fen-*.js - Fen causeway, paths, heart, waystones, trees, stumps, props and dressing; share fen-kit.js and vary geometry/materials by params, seed and scene transform.

scripts/gen/nave-candles.js, nave-drums.js, nave-floor.js, nave-pew.js, nave-pier.js and nave-rafter.js - static Nave/Crypt dressing varied by params and seed; humanoid-locomotion.js is shared by player and wax enemies.
probableOrphans: scripts/gen/wax-figure.js - legacy procedural enemy-figure generator; current wax actors use CDN models.
migrationNotes: Persistent character data is exactly scripts/lib/character.js CHAR_KEYS plus packed position; quest/cut progress and hangmanKilled persist, while movement, menu and presentation scratch remain transient.

Character rows are caller-owned and realm-bound; character.js scopes roster/load/save by owner and realm, while live names are unique per realm. realms.yml room IDs are routing identities, not places in this tree.
The Veil is solo and ephemeral, has no characters, and parks the hidden menu body at its origin; menu framing in camera.js is tuned against that stage's shrine/ledge layout.

The music jukebox is room-shared, not owned independently by each place: main sim changes it for road/fight/boss/Abbey/Fen/Orchard only with an eligible Bearer on main; Veil supplies the menu theme otherwise.

Boss state is separate from ordinary enemy hp: boss scripts publish place.state rows and mark participating Bearers; main sim owns encounter spawning and quest progression. Orchard cut IDs in quest state drive shared hanged-prop visibility.
Floor/gate and landmark coordinates in veilfall-map.js are world metres; Orchard opens at quest stage 18 (or abbeyOpenAll), and GIBBETS IDs/coordinates must match orchard scene props.
